summary: Add reusable transcript grammar primitives and a pairing preview without migrating existing families

replay.detail: Pure kit props; no source records or replay changes.

rules.detail: Marker boundaries are unframed; routine rows are one line; only failed/aborted, human interjections, incoming messages, open questions and expanded results promote to cards. Failed/aborted cards remain expanded. Text-only bodies and typed actions prevent nested cards. Status accents affect glyphs, tags and card hairlines, not labels.

compatibility.detail: Additive root kit exports: TranscriptMarker(label, glyph?, alignment?), TranscriptRow(glyph, verb, subject, excerpt?, tone?, tag?, meta?, disclosure?), TranscriptCard(header, promotion, body, actions?, disclosure?), TranscriptTag(label, tone?), TranscriptMeta(timestamp, now, durationMs?) and TranscriptGlyph(name, tone?). Tone is neutral/running/attention/danger. Existing families are intentionally unchanged pending adoption.

manual.detail: Transcript grammar Storybook previews document tiers, semantic promotion, type scale, glyphs, tags, explicit-clock ages and durations at compact/wide widths in both themes. This proposal stays draft until pairing ratification. Type/rhythm roles derive from composition tokens. formatDuration accepts finite nonnegative milliseconds and floors seconds. formatRelativeAge takes explicit finite Date-range timestamps (inclusive ±8.64e15 ms), clamps future ages to zero and returns label/dateTime/absolute; tooltip text is deterministic UTC, never a row clock. Invalid inputs throw RangeError. Property tests live in the web package to reuse its existing Vitest and fast-check dependencies without modifying protected kit manifests.

recovery.detail: No state migration or recovery changes.
